not_en: Key geological science & landing targets in Jezero crater & Nili Planum, verified on Package v3 20 m CTX and 5 m HiRISE grids.

duraklar.aciklama_en: Flat basin floor at the foot of the western Jezero delta front where Perseverance placed the sample return depot (inside 5 m HiRISE coverage).
Exposed layered strata on the southern bench near Belva crater atop the western Jezero delta fan (inside 5 m HiRISE coverage).
Perseverance touchdown site on the fractured floor unit (Njf), offering smooth basin access toward Seitah and the delta.
Erosional delta remnant south of the main western fan preserving ancient lake level Gilbert-style foreset beds.
Inlet valley breaching Jezero's western rim that fed ancient river sediment into the crater lake.
Highland plains west of Jezero on the 20 m CTX grid (outside the central 5 m HiRISE box; available in the Crewed 20 m scenario).
